scenario_note: Pre-1st-round hypothetical runoff (scenario 1 of several tested)
notes: Found via pt.wikipedia 'Pesquisas de opinião para a eleição presidencial no Brasil em 2026' (row: Alfa Inteligência 18-23 Set, 2700, 1,8, 43/43/14). CartaCapital read directly: 'Nenhum deles/branco/nulo' 7%, 'Não sabe/não respondeu' 7%. Pt-wiki matches (14% combined). Same institute's July round was labelled Alfa/TMC; earlier Alfa PDFs hosted by CNN Brasil. Alfa also registered 2nd-round polls BR-00820/2026 (15-19 Oct, n=2700) and BR-08496/2026 (18-22 Oct, n=1200), not yet released as of 20 Oct.

Published by Times Brasil (CNBC licensee), branded 'American Analytics Times Brasil | CNBC'; sponsor inferred from branding, article does not name a contratante explicitly. TSE number printed as 'BR-032587/26' (non-standard format, possibly a typo for BR-03258/2026 or similar) - recorded as printed. Pt-wiki row matches (43/43/14, n=2000, MoE 2.5).
